novel_features.name: Mirror sync
novel_features.description: Incrementally mirror your Stripe account into a local SQLite database — customers, payment_intents, charges, invoices, subscriptions, refunds, balance_transactions, payouts — with resumable cursors per entity.
novel_features.rationale: Stripe has no first-class local store. stripe-cli is online-only. dj-stripe needs Postgres + Django. A single-binary SQLite mirror is what unlocks every other novel command.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Run this first in any Stripe analytics session — every other novel command queries the local mirror instead of hitting the API.

novel_features.name: Payout explain
novel_features.description: Decompose a payout into every contributing balance_transaction (charges, refunds, fees, adjustments, disputes) with running totals and top-customer attribution.
novel_features.rationale: Only a local mirror with JOIN access to balance_transactions, charges, and customers can answer 'why is this payout $X?' in one command. Stripe Dashboard requires CSV export plus spreadsheet pivoting.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when a founder or finance lead asks 'is this payout right?' — replaces a 15-minute spreadsheet exercise with one CLI call.

novel_features.name: Failed payment triage
novel_features.description: Group failed PaymentIntents by decline_code, customer, or amount band over a date window, with $ at risk and sample customers.
novel_features.rationale: Stripe Dashboard has no group-by-decline-reason view. Search API lags ~1 minute and cannot aggregate. Local SQL over last_payment_error fields is instant.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Morning standup query: 'did anything weird happen overnight?' — answers in one shot what's normally a 5-click dashboard journey.

novel_features.name: Subscription churn audit
novel_features.description: List canceled or past_due subscriptions in a window, grouped by cancellation_details.reason, with MRR delta and customer LTV attribution.
novel_features.rationale: Stripe Sigma costs extra and lags. Dashboard shows individual cancellations, not aggregated $ impact. Only a local subscriptions-to-invoice-items join produces an MRR-weighted churn report.
novel_features.why_it_matters: First-of-the-month query: 'why are we down on MRR?' — turns vague churn into a ranked list of reasons with dollars attached.

novel_features.name: Customer 360
novel_features.description: Join one customer's record with their active subscriptions, lifetime charges and refunds, open invoices, recent activity, and computed lifetime value.
novel_features.rationale: Stripe Dashboard splits this across 5 tabs. @stripe/mcp requires multiple sequential calls bounded by expand[] depth 4. One local query returns the whole picture.
novel_features.why_it_matters: First command on any support ticket — replaces the dashboard scavenger hunt with one CLI call that hands the agent a complete customer record.

novel_features.name: Why did this charge fail
novel_features.description: For a failed charge, return decline_code, network message, that customer's recent successes/failures, and similar failures in the last 7 days.
novel_features.rationale: Today this is 5+ dashboard clicks. A local mirror collapses it to one SQL query with self-joins on decline_code over a 7-day window.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Default agent action when a user pastes a charge ID — gives complete context for refund/retry/dispute decisions without further roundtrips.

narrative.headline: Every Stripe feature, plus a local SQLite mirror, FTS search, and compound-analytics commands no other Stripe tool has.
narrative.value_prop: Mirror your Stripe account into a single-file SQLite database, then ask questions across customers, payments, subscriptions, refunds, and payouts with one command. Designed for agents (JSON, --select, --csv everywhere) and for the finance/RevOps user who lives in the dashboard today.
narrative.auth_narrative: Set STRIPE_SECRET_KEY in your environment. Test-mode keys (sk_test_*) are recommended — `doctor` warns loudly on sk_live_* so you can't accidentally hit production. Auth is Bearer, idempotency keys are auto-injected on every POST.

quickstart.comment: Confirm key works, API reachable, rate-limit headroom available — and surface a warning if you're on a live-mode key.
Mirror your account into local SQLite. Resumable per-entity cursors mean you can stop and restart.
Returns the full customer record — subscriptions, lifetime charges/refunds, open invoices, LTV — in one query.
Morning triage: what's failing and why, grouped instantly with no Search API lag.
Decompose a payout into every underlying balance_transaction with per-customer attribution.

troubleshoots.fix: Set STRIPE_SECRET_KEY to a test key (sk_test_*) from https://dashboard.stripe.com/test/apikeys. Live keys still work but every write prints a confirmation.
Built-in exponential backoff handles spikes; for sync runs add `--rate-limit 10` to slow the request rate (default is 25/s test, 100/s live).
Re-run sync with the same --resources; the cursor resumes from the last successful page. Use --reset to start over.
Run `stripe-pp-cli sync --resources customers,charges,subscriptions,invoices` first — novel analytics commands require the mirror.

narrative.when_to_use: Reach for this CLI when you need to answer a money question about your own Stripe account — who churned, why payments failed, what's in this payout, what's a customer's lifetime value. Use stripe-cli (the official one) for webhook forwarding and event triggering; use this CLI for analyst-style questions and agent-driven workflows that need joined, deterministic, offline-fast answers.
